shots.text: Six lands were gone. Every Warden was free, and every horde that was left turned toward the Heartland at once.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A map of the Ring: six lands dark, grey tides converging from every side on the centre.

shots.text: So the Wardens walked to Solenne.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Six vast figures walking across the plains toward the city, each glowing its own colour: Ignar, Aurath, Elowen, Thalassa, Orrok, Nyxara. Refugees stop to watch them pass.

shots.text: We will hold your walls, little Queen. But before we do, you should know whose walls they are.
shots.speaker: ignar
shots.art_note: The six Wardens standing in a ring around the outer walls of Solenne, the Heartstone pulsing. Ignar kneels to the blind Queen.

shots.text: I gave away my forgetting. So I remember. Vael-Orrun kept the peace between us for forty years. We feared his alchemy, and we wanted his gold.
shots.speaker: thalassa
shots.art_note: Flashback, painted like an old fresco: a young, kind-faced king in grey at a long feast table between six crowned monarchs, his Tidefolk queen and small son beside him. Everyone is smiling.

shots.text:
They came to his feast as friends. At midnight they opened his gates. His city burned, and his wife and his son burned with it.

The songs call it the Siege of Vael. The Wardens call it the Night of Six Knives.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The fresco catches fire: the black city of Vael burning at night, soldiers of six colours in the gates; the king on his knees in the ashes of the feast hall, holding a ring.

shots.text: He did not begin as a tyrant. We made him one. And something was waiting in the dark to finish the work.
shots.speaker: nyxara
shots.art_note: Nyxara, the stars in her face dim, turning away. Behind her, deep in the stars, a patch of sky with no stars in it at all.

shots.text:
The songs had lied for two thousand years. It did not change what we had to do.

It only changed how it felt.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Ysolde alone in the Hall of the Ring, her hand on the Heartstone, which is warm, like a crown just taken off.

shots.text: The Lord Marshal's army was camped at Crossmere, where every road on the Ring meets. That was where we went to meet him.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Crossmere, a crossroads town at night, ringed by a grey war camp. Cassivane's standard: a red field, now burned black.
